root.label: WinSenate ad claims Hinson opposed Epstein files release

events.label: WinSenate ad claims Hinson opposed Epstein files release

slots.name: donor mentions
slots.sentence: “Her top donors appear in the Epstein files over 700 times,” the ad from WinSenate super PAC said, referring to thousands of documents related to criminal investigations into Epstein, the convicted sex offender.

slots.name: billionaire mentions
slots.sentence: “In Congress, Hinson voted against releasing the files,” the ad continued. “When given another chance, she skipped the votes. Instead, she was raising money from a billionaire who’s in the Epstein files over 20 times.”

slots.name: donation amount
slots.sentence: In a separate ad from WinSenate, a woman tells viewers that Hinson “took nearly $90,000 from people in the Epstein files and voted to keep those files secret.”

slots.name: fact check rating
slots.sentence: We rate the claim Mostly False.
